meta.name: compound-learnings
meta.description: Transform session learnings into permanent capabilities (skills, rules, agents). Use when asked to "improve setup", "learn from sessions", "compound learnings", or "what patterns should become skills".

copy.tagline: 把会话经验固化为可复用的技能和规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望每次对话的收获都能变成永久能力
copy.tagline_en: Turn session learnings into reusable skills and rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want every conversation's insights to become permanent capabilities

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你过去对话中的学习记录，找出重复出现的模式，然后自动创建规则、技能或钩子来永久改进你的工作流程。
howto.when: 当你要求“改进设置”、“从对话中学习”、“复合学习”或“哪些模式应该成为技能”时触发。

say.text: 帮我从最近的对话中提取学习模式。
say.note: Claude 会分析最近的学习记录并建议新技能或规则。

say.text: 根据最近的工作改进我的设置。
say.note: Claude 会检查模式并创建或更新规则、技能等。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your past session learnings, identifies recurring patterns, and automatically creates rules, skills, or hooks to permanently improve your workflow.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "improve setup", "learn from sessions", "compound learnings", or "what patterns should become skills".

say_en.text: Extract learning patterns from my recent sessions.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze recent learnings and suggest new skills or rules.

say_en.text: Improve my setup based on recent work.
say_en.note: Claude will examine patterns and create or update rules, skills, etc.
